events.title: 이언 러시 scores his first goal for 리즈 유나이티드 as they beat 첼시 2–0 in the league at Elland Road .
토트넘 홋스퍼 purchase Norwegian striker Steffen Iversen from Rosenborg for £2.5 million.
미들즈브러's slump continues as they lose 2–0 at home to 레스터 시티.

Woking's FA Cup adventure continues with another giant-killing feat, this time a 2–0 win against 케임브리지 유나이티드 at the Abbey Stadium . On the same day, 스티버니지 Borough eliminate 레이턴 오리엔트 from the competition with a 2–1 win at Brisbane Road .
존 스케일스 turns his back on 리즈 유나이티드 after looking set to return to the club where he began his career over a decade ago, and leaves 리버풀 for 토트넘 홋스퍼 in a £2.6 million deal.
Robbie Fowler scores four goals for 리버풀 as they beat 미들즈브러 5–1 in the league at Anfield.
Frank Clark steps down after three-and-a-half years as manager of 노팅엄 포리스트 , with 34-year-old defender 스튜어트 피어스 being appointed player-manager on a temporary basis.
미들즈브러 cancel their Premier League fixture at 블랙번 로버스 tomorrow, after manager 브라이언 롭슨 insisted he could not field a team, as 23 of his playing staff have been hit by a virus.
스튜어트 피어스 brings former 노팅엄 포리스트 striker Nigel Clough back to the City Ground on loan from 맨체스터 시티, more than three years after he left the club for 리버풀.
Division Two strugglers 노츠 카운티 sack joint managers Steve Thompson and Colin Murphy .
미들즈브러 are charged with bringing the game into disrepute over their cancelled fixture.

The key Boxing Day drama sees 잔프랑코 졸라 score both of 첼시's goals in a 2–0 away win over 애스턴 빌라, 고든 스트라컨 lead 코번트리 시티 to a 3–1 away win over his old club 리즈 유나이티드, and 맨체스터 유나이티드 boost their title hopes and deepen their opposition's relegation worries with a 4–0 win at 노팅엄 포리스트.
윔블던 continue to defy the odds and challenge for a place in Europe with a 3–1 away win over 에버턴. 뉴캐슬 유나이티드 continue to push for the title with a 7–1 home win over 토트넘 홋스퍼.

1996 draws to a close with 리버풀 now leading the Premier League, while a mere five points separate the next six highest clubs – 맨체스터 유나이티드, 아스널, 윔블던, 뉴캐슬 유나이티드, 애스턴 빌라 and 첼시. 노팅엄 포리스트 are still bottom with a mere two wins so far this season, while 블랙번 로버스 remain in the drop zone along with 사우샘프턴 who have slipped into the bottom three that has been vacated by an improving 코번트리 시티 side. 볼턴 원더러스 are still top of Division One, but 반즐리 have cut their lead to just two points. 셰필드 유나이티드, 울버햄프턴 원더러스, 크리스털 팰리스 and an 옥스퍼드 유나이티드 side searching for a second successive promotion complete the top six. 맨체스터 시티, who had been expected to feature highly in this season's promotion race, are now one point and one place above the relegation zone.
